name: Rule-ambiguity, clarification and dispute-phase trading (betting on the adjudicator)
one_line: Trade the gap between rule text plus UMA precedent and the price: pre-resolution headline mispricing, the hours after a Polymarket clarification, and the 4-6 day dispute window in which the contract trades on the token vote.
maturity: Emerging: mechanism and frequencies proven on-chain (7.1% of the 2,100 largest markets disputed, 9.5% of the largest 1,000; first proposal overturned in ~16%), no wallet-level PnL public; literal rule reading won 3 of 6 marquee 2026 cases; no live vote on any active market on 28 Sep
requires_ai: optional; LLM adjudicator triage (88-90% agreement after the fact) and rules-diff reading
edge: Vote forecastable from precedent and a concentrated electorate; forced sellers in the dispute window
capital: $1k-$10k; 4-10 day correlated locks, thin books outside marquee cases
build_time: 3-5 weeks solo on an existing stack (monitor + precedent corpus)
opportunity_size: 149 disputes in top 2,100 markets ($4.9B volume); 2-5 tradeable windows a month, some months none; growing count, stalled reform
expected_results: no public data; single cases +5% to +160% per dispute, -100% on a bad vote; guess -$500 to +$400/month at $10k
competition: UMA whales and conflicted voters, rules-focused discretionary traders, LLM triage
flag: none for trading; grey if voting or proposing while positioned; prohibited to delay or pressure
validate: Replay 149+ disputes: second-proposal, rules-literal and LLM strategies vs price; pass +2 pts/trade, t>2
top_risk: Vote contradicts the literal rule (12-16% of cases): binary loss
solo_fit_reason: Everything is observable through free APIs and the precedent corpus compounds with the owner's resolution-sniping stack, but the tradeable set is a few marquee disputes a month (none open today), the price already tracks the vote, and one adverse vote erases months.
speed_class: execution-sensitive: minutes matter for clarifications (Strategy collapsed in four hours), days for votes
results_1k: workable as a study account; -$130 to +$30/month (guess)
results_10k: -$620 to +$360/month (guess, consistent with the -$500 to +$400 gross guess)
min_capital: ~$1k; below it LLM and hosting exceed the edge
capacity_ceiling: per-dispute depth: $10k-50k marquee, hundreds in the tail; ~$50-100k/month solo
changes_made: Maturity kept at Emerging with the literal-rules edge explicitly contradicted by 3 of 6 priced 2026 cases.
Own census: 149 disputed of top 2,100 closed markets, 24 overturned first proposals, 7 active disputes today with a $484-bid book on the largest.
Seven hourly CLOB price paths through disputes and clarifications added; Economics Letters 2026 paper (12.4% overturn, price predicts vote share) added at snippet level.
